_ceiling: PASS is reachable: this is an INSTRUMENT gate, not a physics claim, so no CONTINUUM cap applies. No physics verdict can be produced by this item.
_scope: THE UNTRACKED LAUNCH RECORD. A queue record's _launch block (pid, sid, utc, status_file, started_epoch) is the artifact proving a FROZEN PRE-REGISTRATION WAS ACTUALLY EXECUTED -- VERIFICATION_CHARTER section 9's evidence record. This item measures, per team, how much of that evidence exists ONLY as an untracked file, and whether LAUNCH_LOG.tsv is itself tracked. GATE FAIL here is a FINDING ABOUT THE EVIDENCE RECORD, not a failure of the runs.
_the_only_index_immune_comparison: The driver uses EXACTLY TWO git reads -- `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` against `git hash-object <path>` -- and reads tracked content with `git show HEAD:<path>`, NEVER `git show :<path>` which is the index. git status, git diff, git diff HEAD and git ls-files ALL consult the SHARED INDEX, which on this box stages 431 differences (394 deletions, 37 modifications) of which 372 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to HEAD on disk, so all four MISREPORT here and do so STABLY. The driver enforces this as a subcommand ALLOWLIST THAT RAISES, not as a convention: status, diff, ls-files and add are refused in code.
_remedy_is_to_commit_never_to_delete: The shared index stages the pre-launch copies as DELETIONS while their launched/ destinations were never added, so committing the index as-is would REMOVE THE ONLY TRACKED TRACE AND ADD NOTHING. THESE ARE RENAMES THE INDEX RECORDED AS DELETIONS -- THEY ARE NOT FOSSILS. A GATE FAIL from this item is NOT licence to `git add` or to remove anything; it produces a count and a roll call, and the index is the chief's call.
_smoke: The driver was DRIVEN before enqueue and its controls behaved -- four limbs, the tracked/untracked reader shown returning BOTH answers IN THE SAME INVOCATION. P1 a path proven present at HEAD read TRACKED with a matching blob; P2 a file planted at a path first proven ABSENT from HEAD read UNTRACKED; P3 bytes BYTE-IDENTICAL to a tracked blob planted at an untracked path STILL read UNTRACKED, proving the reader keys on PATH-at-HEAD and not on content; P4 two planted records, one with a _launch block and one without, were classified one each way through the real corpus reader from disk. Every planted file was removed in a finally block and none remained. Drive of 2026-08-30: rc 1, GATE FAIL, 210 records on disk / 169 tracked / 41 untracked / 41 of 41 carrying a _launch block; LAUNCH_LOG.tsv UNTRACKED at 133 rows. Disclosed rather than presented as first contact.

_prereg_commit_is_a_PLACEHOLDER: The 40 zeros in prereg_commit are a DELIBERATE, UNMISTAKABLE placeholder and NOT a freeze. The enqueuing supervisor must replace it with the sha of the commit that lands verification/campaign/VR6_PREREGISTRATION.md, having personally verified the committed blob IS the file that will run (SUPERVISION_CHARTER section 3 check 4, which may never be delegated). scripts/queue_entry_check.py REFUSES this entry until then, which is the intended behaviour: a freeze that does not exist yet must not validate.
cost_basis: c7a.4xlarge at $0.0513/core-h, REPORTED-BY-OWNER, NOT MEASURED -- the box cannot read its own billing (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER.md section 5). ZERO SOLVER COMPUTE: this is a static read-only analysis, so the estimate is interpreter time plus two read-only git subprocesses per queue record.
_estimate_is_measured_not_a_floor: 0.05 core-min is set from MEASUREMENT and from the BUSY-BOX measurement rather than the flattering one. Driven twice on 2026-08-30: 0.806 s wall x 1 rank = 0.013429 core-minutes on a quiet box, and 2.687 s wall = 0.044785 core-minutes with the box at ~80% busy under closure's M1_* sweep -- a 3.3x spread, because the cost is dominated by two git subprocesses per record and subprocess spawn is what contention taxes. The registered estimate is the BUSY figure rounded up; registering 0.02 would have been a number this item had already been measured exceeding. The per-record comparison is deliberately chosen over a single batched read because the per-path comparison is the only index-immune one. Verification's rule-12 calibration of 2026-08-30 found VR1-VR4 estimated 0.5 core-min each against actuals 0.00043 / 0.00176 / 0.00855 / 0.00047, ratio 0.0056; this estimate is set from this item's OWN timing rather than from that floor. Cap 0.5 core-min is ~11x the busy drive, leaving room for corpus growth and further contention; an overrun STOPS the run and does not get a new budget.
